Despite their excitement upon entering the lecture room, they are taken aback by the unexpected presence of someone they did not anticipate encountering. With the new generation members showing off their trendy games, the oldies also show what they are capable of as the masters of variety shows.

videos.title: Dongducheon Class
videos.overview: Excited to try new things and local cuisine in Se-chan's hometown of Dongducheon, the members are mindful of the expenses that come with any trip. With no knowledge of the remaining balance on their accounts, they must manage their spending wisely to avoid maxing out their credit cards and facing penalties for breaking the rules. As tensions rise, the members begin casting suspicious glances at each other, as has often been the case in the past.

videos.title: Perfect Time for Camping (and Play Ttakji!)
videos.overview: The members are always active in keeping up with the latest trends in fashion, music, and clothing, with Haha being singled out by Jae-suk as the most enthusiastic. While in Suncheon, they engage in a game of ttakji to determine who among them will be treated to a lavish lunch. The competition heats up as the staff joins the fray, with the stakes now raised for dinner.

videos.title: Perfect Time for Camping (and Play Ttakji!) (2)
videos.overview: The members need to prepare the dinner for themselves, and as is the always the case, the scene becomes a total mess when everyone starts to meddle in. The worst is So-min. She tries to make a soup for everyone, but the soup turns into something that Jae-suk hates the most. After the culinary disaster, they must play ttakji, the outcome of which will determine whether they have a comfortable night's sleep or a chilly one in their tents.

videos.title: Do You Know Beautiful Scholars?
videos.overview: It's been many years since the members started behaving shamelessly on Running Man, but this time, they've gone a little too far. Among the beautiful scholars, there is one who doesn't fit the group. Games are played and hints are traded, all to find the one who doesn't belong. Unless they single out the outcast, it will only be a matter of time before they get the penalties themselves. Stay tuned!

videos.title: Fighting Fan-meet, Running Man in Philippines
videos.overview: The members and staff waited three years preparing for this meet and greet in the Philippines. Despite their eagerness to express gratitude to their fans, they still have missions to fulfill. Once the missions are completed, the members gather at the venue for rehearsals, their hearts brimming with excitement that's hard to contain.

videos.title: No Coin, No Gain
videos.overview: Meeting with Manny Pacquiao, their beloved friend, in the Philippines and sharing a meal at his grand mansion is a rare and special occasion for the group. Knowing that such opportunities do not come by every day, they are thrilled to spend a delightful day with him. However, all great things come at a cost, and the members are surprised by the unexpected challenge of R coins, igniting a race to resolve it.

videos.title: Running Tour Project
videos.overview: The staff is organizing the Running Tour Project, which is a significant undertaking that will give members the chance to travel to their desired destinations. In a show of generosity, the staff is offering members the opportunity to earn travel budgets, and all members need to do is work cohesively. However, the situation takes a turn for the worse as some members begin to betray their colleagues for personal gain, causing chaos and eroding trust among the team.

videos.title: TV Rating Notice Art Exhibition, Part 1
videos.overview: The members have been split into three teams for a high-stakes race that will determine the future of the TV rating notice's new concept. The victorious team will earn the exclusive opportunity to showcase their idea prominently at the beginning of all upcoming episodes, ensuring their brilliance shines brighter than the rest. The drawing will be divided into seven fragments, and those who retrieve them will have the freedom to revise them as they see fit. And so, the race commences.

videos.title: TV Rating Notice Art Exhibition, Part 2 / 2023 So-min's Choice (1)
videos.overview: In this week's episode, the TV Rating Notice theme has been decided through Seven Person Banksy, and the members will dress up according to the chosen drawing. Meanwhile, for poor So-min, who always fails to team up with the guest of her choice, there will be a special episode for her, which is called 2023 So-min's Choice Race. Se-ho and Kang Hoon join the team this week, and So-min gets to choose her teammate through a quiz.

videos.title: 2023 So-min's Choice (2)
videos.overview: In this week's episode, the battle between Team Jeon So-min and Team No So-min continues with Se-ho and Kang Hoon. So-min always has been a ref for sports games, but she finally becomes a top player in 2023 So-min's Choice Race. Stay tuned to check out the impressive moments of So-min and Name Tag Elimination at a huge used car store in Cheongna.

videos.title: You Are My Bong
videos.overview: Kim Dong-hyun, the friendly family member of Running Man, is here as a guest. Today, he and Se-chan will lead their teams to victory. They will participate in games that need both physical strength and strategic ideas. Depending on the Golden and Fake eggs that they get along the way, the winning and losing teams will be decided.

videos.title: Ji-hyo's Detox Tour
videos.overview: Continuing from a few weeks back, Ji-hyo gets to plan her trip any way she likes, so she sets up the "Detox Tour" for the entire crew where the members have to follow exactly what Ji-hyo says. If anyone resists, they will be punished. Some members enjoy it while others think it's the worst thing

videos.title: I'm a Single's Inferno (1)
videos.overview: In this week's episode, Variety Solos are here at Variety Solo World to find their Variety Mates! With a rising star, Dex, and familiar actresses, Lee Se Hee and Han Ji Eun, joining the show, they create a complicated drama, which no one expected. They have to fight each other to get the votes. Will they be able to find their mates? Stay tuned!

videos.title: I'm a Single's Inferno (2) / The Lucky 29th
videos.overview: In this week's episode, Lucky 29th Race begins with the members choosing their favorite number between 0 to 9. When the race ends, they will pick one number card out of the two numbers, 2 and 9. Three members who have completed or are the coolest to the number will get the golden R coins. Who will be the lucky members with the lucky number? Stay tuned!

videos.title: Fight Heat with Noodles
videos.overview: In this week's race, they have to complete one straight line on a bingo board with a variety of summer noodle dishes. They only get to eat the recommended dishes from citizens to check a slot on the board, and they need at least three different dishes to complete it. Will they be able to get off work just in three attempts? Stay tuned for Fight Heat with Noodles Race!

videos.title: Forget-About-Age Party
videos.overview: In this week's episode, Joohoney and Yun Sung Bin join the members to have Go Away Age Party at Running Man. They are divided into two teams, Team Jong Kook and Team Sung Bin, to play games. There are various prizes ready for the party, and the team that earns more R coins wins the prizes. Stay tuned for a match of pride between Jong Kook and Sung Bin!

videos.title: Running Scout Festival
videos.overview: The members are invited to the first Running Scout Festival. There will be various limited edition badges, and the members have to collect them through games. They can exchange badges at a store for money. Which one of them will finish this race with a truckload of cash? Stay tuned!

videos.title: Along with the Gamblers
videos.overview: The seven gamblers from Joseon Dynasty are coming to win a fortune in just one day. With the candies they've earned through the race, they can purchase a talisman that they can use during the final table game. The moment a talisman is activated, the flow of the game will be completely upset. Who will be the best gambler in the country? Stay tuned!

videos.title: Yoo Jae-suk's Exploration of Cultural Heritage
videos.overview: In this week's episode, the members go on the second trip of the Running Tour Project designed by Jae-suk, called Yoo Jae-suk's Exploration of Cultural Heritage. With enthusiastic Professor Yu, they arrive at Gyeongju the day before the shoot to join the tour early next morning. They will have history quizzes throughout the tour and get a Running Ball each time they score. With the Running Balls, they decide on the next trip designer for the Running Tour Project.

videos.title: Summer Vacation Special, Running Man Outing
videos.overview: In this week's episode, the members will carry out outdoor games and missions at Grandma's house in a village for their summer vacation. After each activity, they will write down a picture journal about things they did well and things they want other members to work on. Based on the vote, they will get the coupons to win the prize of 3 million won.

videos.title: Summer Vacation Special, Running Man Outing Part 2
videos.overview: The race in the mud continues with Se Chan and Jong Kook. Will Se Chan be able to create a twist against Jong Kook? Meanwhile, there will be a table tennis match that comes with a penalty everyone hates. Which team will need to wake up at the crack of dawn to pick bell peppers and make breakfast next morning? Stay tuned for their fiery games!

videos.title: Summer Vacation in Fishing Village, Running Man Outing
videos.overview: This time, the members spend a day at an elderly gentleman's house in the fishing village. From early morning, they harvest sea urchins and make breakfast with them from scratch. In the evening, they play games to pick two unlucky members for the worst penalty. Who will end up on the octopus boat? Stay tuned!

videos.title: Summer Vacation Special Part 2: Fishing Village
videos.overview: They continue with the second game, which is Kim Jong Kook Game, to turn the tables around. After the games, the members are divided into two teams to prepare dinner. Team Market is in charge of grocery shopping, but will they be able to stay on task without being tempted to eat out at a restaurant? Stay tuned to find out more!

videos.title: A Midsummer Night's Detective
videos.overview: On the last night of Summer Vacation Special, the members have a revenge match of table tennis. This time, they have to play with special rackets that suit the heat of summer. Who will be the loser to go on a fishing boat the next morning? Meanwhile, Detectives on a Summer Night Race begins with a guest, Kang Hoon, joining the members. They have to win hint tickets through missions before they receive a request. They can use their hint tickets to solve the mystery case. Stay tuned to find out more!

videos.title: A Midsummer Night's Detective, Part 2
videos.overview: The eight great detectives get given two new cases revolving around two mysterious murders. After splitting up into two groups, they face each other in a quest to find the suspects. Which odd pairing will have what it takes to look for evidence, find clues, and earn hints as they battle their fears in a gruesomely horror-filled theme?

videos.title: Land Grab in V-topia
videos.overview: This week, V of BTS joins the show during his layover as a wealthy landowner with plots of land all over the country. Each region possesses a specialty food that tenant farmers must fight for. However, V makes all the decisions according to each tenant farmer's performance. The one with the most coins wins, and they get a shot at overthrowing V's control. Will V keep all his land and reap the riches?

videos.title: Money Road in Daehangno
videos.overview: The Running Man members head over to Daehakro for the Money Road in Daehakro Race. At each venue they visit, they will complete a mission where the winner gets to distribute the prize money to the members. However, they can object to the amount they get given and revolt. If that happens, there is a chance more members will get the penalty at the end of the race. Who will escape the punishment?

videos.title: Amnesiac Couples' War
videos.overview: Inherent complexity already surrounds love relationships, but the members aim to discover both the popular and suitable individuals for themselves. However, amnesia stemming from a tragic accident presents a compelling and daunting obstacle. The popular figures remain concealed within the group of nine, initiating a search that promises eventual chaos. Clues offer only vague guidance in narrowing down the potential candidates. Can they ultimately find their genuine soulmates?

videos.title: "Yoo" Are My Captain
videos.overview: Yoo Seung Ho, Kim Dong Hwi, and Yu Su Bin will join today's race! They will split up into two teams with the members and make money deals with the production crew led by the Mask Man. However, the money must cascade within the team, so it's all about loyalty and greed. The three with the most money win a prize, and the three with the least amount face the penalty. Which team captain will lead them to victory?

videos.title: The Escape of the Ten
videos.overview: Um Ki Joon, Yoon Jong Hoon, and Lee Joon, three survivors of "The Escape of the Seven," join the show in this week's race, The Escape of the Ten. Their objective of the race is to figure out what crime they have committed in order to escape. Through a variety of missions, they have the chance to win coins to buy hints of their sins. The race starts now.

videos.title: Minority's Paradise
videos.overview: Hoshi, Seungkwan, and DK from SEVENTEEN join the cast in this week’s Minority’s Paradise Race. A big red button will determine their fates in the race. The ratio of those who choose to press it against those who don't will decide if they go to Paradise or to the Inferno. Through a series of missions, they get a chance to win coins that will help them escape facing the punishment in the final round. Who will live in Paradise, and who will suffer in the Inferno?

videos.title: Fall Food Talk
videos.overview: MIYEON from (G)I-DLE and Mimi from OH MY GIRL are here for this week's Fall Gourmet Party Race! They will enjoy some of the best fall dishes only if they win in the missions. However, after each challenge, they will either collect multiple prize badges or penalty badges that will get drawn at the end, determining their fate. What tasty fall menus will entice their competitive spirit?

videos.title: The Dream of a Million Dollars
videos.overview: In this week's episode, a hide-and-seek game worth 1,000 dollars begins. The members have to find the hidden prize envelope with 1,000 dollars. The person whose name is written last on the prize envelope gets the prize money. However, there's a hidden rule that will determine two members who will get the penalty of the day. Who will be able to protect the prize until the end?

videos.title: Goodbye, So Min
videos.overview:
Jeon So Min Tour

After seven years, it's the last episode of Running Man for So Min. The cast and crew dedicate this day to So Min and give her the Goodbye So Min Tour, where she gets to do things she likes one last time with the whole cast. However, there are hidden missions that the members must do to get out of the penalty. Watch the heart-rendering moments the cast shares with So Min as they say their goodbyes.

videos.title: Do You Want to Win in Singapore?
videos.overview: This week, Running Man races in Singapore! It's the Do You Want to Win in Singapore? race, and there is a luxurious prize on the line. Guests Shin Ye Eun and Hong Jin Ho join the race to lead a team of their own. While picking random cards and keeping their greed at bay, they get to enjoy the best Singapore has to offer. Which team will get the extravagant prize in Singapore?

videos.title: Singapore Pay-It-All Package Trip
videos.overview:
Part Two in Singapore

The race in Singapore continues! In teams of two, they will compete in missions where the winning team enjoys the trip for free at the losing team's expense. The team with the most money left will win the race, and the team with the least will face an embarrassing penalty. What fabulous meals and trips will Singapore provide?

videos.title: Card Sharks, Paradise of the Gamblers
videos.overview:
The Battle of Card Sharks

Yoo Seung Ho and V make a return to Running Man, with Seung Ho seeking payback for the previous insults he endured on the show. In this special card shark episode, participants aim to accumulate as many caramels as they can, which play a crucial role in the upcoming challenges. V, armed with sharp wit, successfully takes control of the caramel stash, while Seung Ho struggles with various tasks.

videos.title: Suk Jin's Early 60th Birthday Trip
videos.overview:
Seok Jin's Early 60th Birthday Trip

It's Se Chan's turn to host a trip for the members, and he plans to throw an early 60th birthday party for Seok Jin. Although the budget isn't as much as he needs, he manages to pull off everything he thinks Seok Jin deserves. From a floral palanquin to a comedy show and his favorite foods, Seok Jin gets showered with adoration. Will Seok Jin enjoy his birthday party?

videos.title: Come Empty, Return Empty: The Emptying War
videos.overview: Joo Hyun Young, Tsuki, and Kwon Eun Bi are here to race with the cast for as many R coins in a free-for-all, grab-and-dash race! However, there's a catch that the members don't learn about until it's too late. Ironically, less is more, and the people with the most left will face the penalty. But hope is not all lost. They get the chance to discard them by winning missions. Let the Come Empty, Return Empty race begin.

videos.title: Will It Snow on Christmas?
videos.overview:
Will I Get a Present for Christmas?

In this week's episode, Kim Dong Hyun and TOMORROW X TOGETHER are here for the Christmas Eve Race with Running Man. To get as many presents as possible on Christmas, the members of TOMORROW X TOGETHER are fast asleep in a bedroom. Meanwhile, Dong Hyun and the mischievous members of Running Man have to wake the boys up within ten minutes. Will they be able to get a present for Christmas? Stay tuned!

videos.title: Running Villa in Crisis
videos.overview: In this week's episode, a crisis falls on the peaceful Running Villa. As the level of disaster keeps increasing, they have to find the bank card with the maintenance fees and repair the house. However, the more they try to repair it, the more problems they run into. Will they be able to overcome the crisis? Stay tuned!

videos.title: The 2nd Winter Festival
videos.overview: In this week's episode, the 2nd Winter Festival takes place to celebrate the new year, and Kyu Hyun, Cho Sae Ho, and Eom Ji Yoon join the members for the fishing tournament! They will play games to acquire the fish traps with different types of bait. The more fish they catch, the higher the chance they'll win a prize. Who will be the winner to take the luxurious prize home? Stay tuned!

videos.title: Is This the Table I Like?
videos.overview: In this week's episode, the members will travel back to the Joseon Dynasty and find the six dishes for King Seok Sam. Each team has to find three dishes with the names from the Joseon Dynasty on time, and the team members can get prizes if they prepare all three dishes correctly. However, a terrible penalty awaits for those who fail to find the dishes. Will they be able to prepare a royal table for King Seok Sam?

videos.title: Suk Jin Oswa, Health Oswa
videos.overview: After 28 days of rest, Jee Seok Jin is back to join the cast! He receives a warm welcome and a surprise health checkup with all members. Healthy rewards can be theirs, even gold, if they fulfill the health standards that will light up the five smiley faces at the Running Health Center. Will they pass the health checkup and keep their stress levels low and heart rates normal to win the prizes?

videos.title: Wonderful Value for Money
videos.overview: In this week's episode, the members have the Wonderful Value for Money Race. They visit places where they can have a hearty meal at a reasonable price despite the price hikes. Unlike usual, the three members with the least money left from their mission fund win the race and get amazing prizes. Who will be the winners to spend all they have on a cost-efficient food tour? Stay tuned!

videos.title: The Ji Family Returning Favor
videos.overview: To celebrate Lunar New Year's Day, the Jee family gathers to return the favor to those who helped them on the show while Seok Jin was away. They make New Year's food for them and give them a chance to win Lunar New Year presents as well. Who will be the lucky guests to have a delicious meal and get a special gift from the Jee family? Stay tuned!

videos.title: Legendary Gold Bar
videos.overview: In this week's episode, the members search a mansion for the missing legendary gold bar with Bo Hyun and Ji Hyun. They fight to get crucial clues about the gold bar through debates, interrogations, and games. The member who finds the gold bar will be the sole winner and get the prize today. Who will be the owner of the legendary gold bar?

videos.title: I Will Win in My Next Life
videos.overview: In this week's episode, the members and the guests return to the past and live a new life! With the information they have from the future, they get to invest in various fields to increase their assets. However, they have to invest their money wisely as they will be sent to random periods each round. Who will be the winner in the next life? Stay tuned!

videos.title: To Become the Top Student
videos.overview: Team Jae Seok made a successful investment at first, but completely fell to the bottom when they time-traveled to the 2000s. However, they get one last opportunity to rise to the top. Will they be able to turn the table? Meanwhile, the members start school as freshmen for the entering class of 2024, and they compete with one another to earn the scholarship through various campus activities. Stay tuned!

videos.title: Star Teach Yoo Jae Suk's History Trip With the Empty Heads
videos.overview: In this week's episode, the seven empty heads go on a history tour with Star Lecturer Yu Jae Seok to learn about Joseon Dynasty. With a matching team uniform, the members set off to Injeongjeon in Changdeokgung Palace. After exploring each spot, Star Lecturer Yu will give history quizzes, and those who give correct answers will receive benefits. However, one member with the fewest points will get a penalty.

videos.title: Running Old Restaurant Marble
videos.overview: The members are excited to visit longstanding restaurants that have been operating for generations, yet they are unaware of the extent of their culinary journey. Beginning with a 92-year-old ox-tail soup place, they embark on a gastronomic exploration of historic restaurants, each with a minimum of 30 years of heritage. Thus, the feast commences.

videos.title: The 1st Futsal Running Cup
videos.overview: With Jae Seok and Jong Kook leading their respective teams, the two sides engage in a competitive futsal match. Because of the limited number of members, both teams are allowed to recruit players externally. Jae Seok's team reaches out to Oh Ha Young from Apink, who initially responds to Haha's call with caution. On the other hand, Jong Kook identifies Kang Hoon as a potential asset for his team and reaches out to him. An intense futsal showdown commences.

videos.title: So Hip It Hurts
videos.overview: In Seongsu-dong, members have the opportunity to experience three exciting courses, all by rolling dice to cover the costs. Each member receives six dice. Following each course, members roll their dice in private. They deduct ten dollars for each point rolled from the total cost of the course. If there's still an outstanding balance, it converts into debt. The number of members penalized depends on the amount of debt incurred. Those penalized will have to sport a pantsless look for next week's shoot. Stay tuned!

videos.title: Spring Has Come to TV Rating Notice
videos.overview: To serve the penalty from last week's race, the members adopted a pantsless theme, wearing outfits with extremely short bottoms. Dressed in these distinctive attires, they participate in a poster shoot for the show, playfully admonishing Jae Seok for his lackluster bottom. Following this, they embark on a mission to navigate a 50km course, pausing at renowned spring food destinations along the route. Stay tuned to discover if they succeed in completing the rating notice shoot.

videos.title: Sweet and Sweet 7,000 Dollars
videos.overview: In honor of the 700th episode of the longest-running show Running Man, the cast bands together for challenges to win a prize of 7,000 dollars. Initially united, tensions rise as they face difficult tasks like spinning 360 degrees on a swing and hitting a small target with a dart. Though they conquer challenges as a team, greed surfaces when it's time to share the prize, sparking a race for personal gain.

videos.title: The 2nd Futsal Running Cup
videos.overview: FC Ttuk and FC Kook, led by Manager Ttuk and Manager Kook respectively, are set to clash in the 2nd Futsal Running Cup. Manager Ttuk, fueled by the desire for revenge after their prior defeat, is determined to turn the tables this time around. However, despite recruiting new members for today's game, he finds himself dissatisfied with the lineup he's assembled.

videos.title: The Future of Han-na's Day
videos.overview: In this episode, the cast prepares for The Future of Han Na's Day race, where they'll compete according to the rules outlined in Han Na's notebook. What started as a mere guide has transformed into a rigid code, pushing the members to search desperately for it, hoping to tweak the instructions in their favor. As revisions pile up, penalties increase, fueling fiercer competition. Meanwhile, Han Na stands firm, determined to safeguard her notebook at all costs.

videos.title: Go, Stop Race Returns
videos.overview: In this episode, Eun Bi makes a bold return to the show despite being banned by the members. She joins the rest of the cast as they head toward Ganghwa Island. The members playfully rib Eun Bi for her audacity in coming back, especially after her history of tricking Jong Kook. Surprisingly, the more they tease her, the more shameless she becomes. Eventually, she even considers filling an empty spot on the show. With Eun Bi seeming to fit in better than some of the original members, the quizzes carry on.

videos.title: I Have to Come in First Place
Running Summer Games with the National Athletes
The Unlucky Family is Here
videos.overview: Keum Sae Rok and Hong Jin Ho join the cast as today's guests in the Unlucky Family is Here Race. Two families of the Unlucky Family gather for one of the biggest national holidays, Chuseok. They battle each other for the unluckiest draws for chances to alter a three-level roulette board that will determine a prize or a penalty. Which family of the Unlucky Family will be unfortunate enough to leave with a gift or lucky enough to be shamed with a penalty?

videos.title: The Perfect Code
videos.overview: Kwon Eun Bi and Jonathan Yiombi join as guests in today's The Perfect Code Race. Each Running Man member starts with seed money they get from a random QR code they scan at the start of the race. Eun Bi and Jonathan will have different tasks to earn their money. With that seed money, the members and the guests will scan QR codes in missions to make it grow. In the end, they race with QR codes on their backs with questions they must answer to eliminate the other to earn even more money to determine who faces the penalty.

videos.title: A Retreat with Pirate Roulette
videos.overview: Haewon from NMIXX and Kim Dong Jun of ZE:A join the cast for this week's A Retreat With Pirate Roulette Race as guests. The one who makes the pirate pop will get to call it a day and go straight home. Those who fail will stay to face a penalty. Furthermore, they will only get to eat if they can pop the pirate with the amount of knives they collect through missions and games. Who will get to eat and go home early?

videos.title: The Boss of the Alley
videos.overview: This week, it's the Boss of the Alley Race! The members are in for a treat only if they are the Alley Boss. They will visit the many famous food alleys in Seoul, and for each alley, they will fight in a game of slap-match to determine the Alley Boss. The Ally Boss will choose what they eat and won't have to pay. They will also pick two members to eat with them. The others will have to cover the costs. At the end of the race, the three members with the least amount of mission funds left will face a penalty.

videos.title: Tenacious Dieters to Keep Weight Off
videos.overview: This week, the members' willpower gets put to the test. In the Tenacious Dieters to Keep Weight Off Race, they need to beat the scale throughout the day as they take on missions to keep the weight off and maintain their initial weigh-in as a group. If they go over one kilogram, they risk coming in an hour earlier for the shoot. They get four weigh-in chances, and each failure adds an hour to the penalty. Who will keep their appetite in check?

videos.title: Hierarchical Clan
videos.overview: Woo Do Hwan and Lee You Mi join the members in the special episode "The Head Family the Pecking Order." In this thrilling race, everyone plays descendants of a prestigious family, choosing roles as kings, nobles, or slaves, but their status can change at any moment. Who will rise and who will fall? Stay tuned to find out!

videos.title: I Can't Live Without Money
videos.overview: Kim Ah Young, Seo Eun Kwang, and Lee Min Hyuk join this week's I Can't Live Without Money Race. They will split into two teams, and the team with the most points will win money while the other faces a penalty. There will be Money Challenges in each round where they pick random money briefcases with a positive or negative amount. Whether they stop or keep going will be up to them. Mystery briefcases will also be available with a jackpot, a penalty ticket, or a bomb to entice their greed. Who will win this week's race?

videos.title: Be Clever to Trust
videos.overview: Hong Kyung, Roh Yoon Seo, and Kim Min Ju are here to promote their new movie, "Hear Me: Our Summer." They get to show off their wits and acting skills against the members in this week's Be Clever to Trust race. Three teams will compete to make a three-digit number using the number each member picks at random. However, the member with the highest holding number of the winning team won't win the prize, and the highest holding number of the losing team will have a higher chance of getting the penalty. Who will sacrifice themselves for the team? And who will deceive to escape the penalty?

videos.title: Presumptuous Election for Class President
videos.overview: Kim Dong Jun joins the cast again, along with RAMI and RORA from BABYMONSTER, in this week's Presumptuous Election for Class President Race. Dressed in their high school uniforms, the cast and guests elect a class president, following a specific theme, who then will have the power to designate teams to fight for badges. At the end of the race, the one with the fewest badges and two randomly picked people will face the penalty.

videos.title: The Wise Odd and Even Choices
Resolve to Part Ways with 2024
videos.overview: On today's Running Man, under the theme of "Decision to Leave 2024," actor Kang Hoon returns after five months as the cast shares items they want to leave behind from 2024. Haha blames snacks for his weight struggles, Ye Eun jokes about her scale and weight, Jae Seok reminisces about an old belt from the 2000s, and Jong Kook vents about a broken electric bike.

videos.title: The Person Who Laughs in Paradise
Going Up the TV Rating Notice
How a Giant Snake Becomes a Dragon
Let There Be a New Family
Merchant Chronicles: You Must Make Money To Survive
A Good Day to be Solo
The More You Shoot, The More You Succeed
Territorial Expansion of Killers
videos.overview: The long-standing turf war between the Locust Gang and the Tiger Gang is finally ending. Son Ho Jun and Yoo Seong Ho join the cast as special guests in this week's explosive race of Territorial Expansion of Killers. Multiple battlegrounds await, with the victorious gang claiming the spoils of each turf. Meanwhile, the losers must endure harsh penalties. Who will conquer and who will fall?

videos.title: Skilled Running Family
videos.overview: It's May, Family Month, and MIYEON and SOYEON of i-dle join the cast for a playful race packed with secret missions and quick-witted challenges at locations fit for the holidays celebrated in the month. The members and guests who successfully carry out their required actions will get rewarded, while those who fail will face a penalty. Who has the wits and brains to crack the missions and gain the advantage?

videos.title: Vote in Spring
videos.overview: Lee Seung Hyub of N.Flying and actress Park Ji Hu join the cast at a vibrant amusement park in Chuncheon for the Spring Voting Race. Over three intense rounds, members face different voting methods, each offering unique benefits to the winners. But with every vote, the stakes grow, and those who lose must endure penalty missions. As pressure mounts and the final penalty looms, tensions rise, and strategies clash. Who will survive the race without facing the penalty?

videos.title: Drawing Road Trip
videos.overview: This week, the cast goes on a Drawing Road Trip, where Jae Seok's drawings determine their fate. With only five seconds to draw, Jae Seok's drawings must be good enough for random people to guess the location correctly to move on to the next spot. They must reach a total of three destinations by 4pm. If they don't complete the mission on time, they will go on the terrifying Gyro Swing ride as a team penalty before they go home. Will they make it?

videos.title: Gamblers in the City
videos.overview: Kim Ah Young is back to stir up the hearts of Se Chan and Daniel in this summer-themed race all about Korea's first that started in Incheon. Each of the three levels of cards, gold, silver, and bronze, will have five cards, which only contain one, two, and three factual real cards, respectively, that will determine the prize level they can win. Three teams will race to find the real cards to win the prize, while those who get it wrong will face the penalty.

videos.title: The Empty Head Avengers Competition
videos.overview: This week, the cast hosts the Empty Head Avengers Competition to find out who's the smartest and the most clueless among Song Ji Hyo, Yang Se Chan, Choi Daniel, and Ji Ye Eun. Meanwhile, the remaining four Brainiacs will place bets using special summer-themed betting money. It's a fierce contest within teams, where every point counts. Only the top scorers will boost their odds of escaping the final penalty. How will the Empty Heads rank?

videos.title: Miracle Breakfast Morning
videos.overview: This week's Miracle Breakfast Morning Race catches the cast by surprise. It's a game of bingo with the dishes they said they wanted to eat, but the only way to cross one out is if a random person says that's the dish they want for breakfast. If they cross out three in a row within the set time limit, they get to go home early. If they fail, they face the penalty. Let's see who has the stomach to take on a massive breakfast feast.

videos.title: A Creepy Vacation Thriller
videos.overview: Asa and Ahyeon of BABYMONSTER, along with Joo Hyun Young, join the cast in this week's Creepy Vacation Thriller Race. In this upgraded three-horror-themed getaway course, members must choose to bravely volunteer for each course or leave their fate to chance by drawing a black or gold ball, leading to either prize balls or penalty balls. Tension runs high, but will they muster the courage to step forward, or leave it up to luck in this chilling summer race?

videos.title: Back to 2010
videos.overview: Running Man marks its 15th anniversary with a special guest appearance by SUPER JUNIOR, who are also celebrating 20 years! In this week's You Could Win Gold Today race, everything revolves around collecting R coins. The more they earn, the higher their chances of winning Running Man's ultimate prize, gold. But with fewer coins, the risk of facing a harsh penalty rises. What outrageous games await in this chaotic and unforgettable anniversary celebration?

videos.title: Splitting Gamblers
videos.overview: MIYEON joins the cast in the stunning historic city of Gyeongju for this week's Splitting Gamblers Race, which was inspired by the region's unique seashell artifacts. Each member selects one shell they believe will be the hardest to break among the many on display. In the final showdown, they'll try to smash each other's shells, while hoping their shells don't break. The last player with their shell intact wins the prize, while the rest earn penalty balls in the draw. Who will outlast the shell-cracking chaos?

videos.title: Happy Ye-eun Day
videos.overview: The cast arrives at Ye Eun's stunning new home, ready to celebrate her birthday with carefully chosen gifts. But their offerings must pass the ultimate test from the picky new homeowner, who values her aesthetic above all else. Some friendships might not survive the vibe check.

videos.title: Roulette Battle of Weak Loyalty
videos.overview: Nam Woo Hyun, Kim Ha Neul, and Lee Jun Young join the cast for this week's Roulette Battle of Weak Loyalty Race, where unexpected alliances take center stage. A large roulette wheel with 60 empty slots will slowly fill through missions and games with their names. They will spin the roulette wheel at the end to determine which three members will get the prize or the penalty. However, if it lands on an empty slot, all members suffer the penalty. Who will walk away with the reward, and who will fall victim to the roulette of fate?

videos.title: 2025 Daytime Goblin Room Tour
videos.overview: The cast sets off on the 2025 Day Goblin's Tour, but this vacation is all about winning R coins! Starting with seed money, members choose from a variety of themed travel rooms, each with its own entrance fee and challenges. Inside, they'll take on games and missions, risking their coins for the chance to earn more. In the end, they'll use their winnings to buy a souvenir, while those who can't afford one will face the penalty. Who will spend smart and who will go broke?

videos.title: Between Masterpiece and Failure
videos.overview: Seo Jang Hoon, Shin Gi Ru, and Shindong join the cast for this week's Between Masterpiece and Failure Race. Two rival artist families, the Kims led by Jong Kook and the Yus led by Jae Seok, go head-to-head in a drawing showdown to see who can create the most valuable masterpiece. AI will evaluate each work by assigning a price to determine its worth. The winning family claims prizes, while the losers face the penalty. Which family of artists will reign supreme?

videos.title: Running Sports University Prize Battle
videos.overview: This week, the Running Sports University Prize Battle Race gets underway with world champion judo siblings Kim Min Jong and Kim Ha Yoon as guests. Before each training session begins, members compete in games to earn Running Balls, which can be placed into raffle boxes. When a box exceeds ten balls, a raffle is drawn for prizes. Winners gain immunity from the penalty, while those left without prizes face imminent doom. The games are tense and the prizes grand. Who will have the luck to win!

videos.title: Date Bursting With Luck
videos.overview: This week, Kim Ah Young and Jang Dong Yoon join the cast for the "Spend More, Get Lucky: Jackpot Date!" Inspired by the Sangsaeng Consumption Lottery, the cast pairs up for a special spending race where every purchase over a set amount earns them a lottery ticket. Along the way, games and missions allow them to earn extra Running Money, which determines their order of spending on a date. At the end, the three members with the highest totals will win prizes, while three unlucky random players face penalties. Who will strike it rich, and who will pay the price?

videos.title: Time Attack, Prize and Penalty Fighter
videos.overview: The cast kicks off with a 20-minute challenge right off the bat. Gather in one area by using a walkie-talkie with only a 300m range, or risk being added to the penalty list every time each member misses the mark. The reward? An early finish with only prizes in hand. Once together, they dive into the Time Attack Win, Lose Fighter Race, where every second counts. If all tasks are cleared by four, prizes await. Will the members push through to earn an early escape, or fall victim to penalties?

videos.title: Go Straight as You Answer
videos.overview: This week's race is Go Straight with Your Answer! Based on the questionnaires the cast fills out earlier, the answers will get randomly pieced together into a complete sentence that will decide today's missions. Ranging from destinations to activities, everything gets determined by chance, and the stakes are high. If they can't complete the mission by 3 p.m., everyone will face a massive team penalty. Will the cast have answers that will lead them to triumph, or send them on a chaotic detour to disaster?

videos.title: Congratulatory Delegation With Kook's Patience
videos.overview: Jong Kook's best friend, Cha Tae Hyun, joins us for this week's Congratulatory Delegation with Kook's Patience race to celebrate Jong Kook's marriage. But for someone who cringes at even a birthday song, today's over-the-top party is pure torture. Through missions, the members will try to remove corny and fussy celebration items, while Jong Kook collects chance cards to his advantage. Every chance card he uses adds another penalty member. Will Jong Kook endure the embarrassment, or will the celebration spiral out of control?

videos.title: Dear CEO, Give Me the Salary
A World Where Only the Average Survives
videos.overview: The cast of "Run to the West" joins Running Man for a special race titled A World Where Only the Average Survives. In this unconventional competition, excelling or failing is equally dangerous. Only those who land squarely in the middle can win. Members get split into two balanced teams, and each mission will test their ability to stay perfectly average. The third-place finisher on each team claims the prize, while everyone else risks facing the penalty. Can they resist their competitive instincts and master the art of mediocrity?

videos.title: The Finders Keepers, Gold Hungers Race
videos.overview: Yang Se Hyeong and Jeon So Min join in this week's Finders Keepers, Gold Hungers Race that sends the cast on a high-stakes treasure hunt with real gold on the line. Fifty gold coins worth over a thousand dollars are hidden across the area, waiting to be discovered. Using metal detectors and special tools earned through missions, the members must rely on both luck and strategy to uncover the treasure. Every coin they find is theirs to keep, but with gold fever spreading fast, competition turns fierce. Who will strike it rich, and who will leave empty-handed?

videos.title: Photographers Who Capture Time
videos.overview: This week's race, Photographers Who Capture Time, challenges the cast, along with solo guest Jonathan Yiombi, to submit their best photos to a special photo biennale, but with a twist. Each of the three photo locations is accessible only at a specific time, and they must arrive exactly on schedule without knowing the actual time. With all clocks covered and phones confiscated, they'll have to rely on instinct, teamwork, and maybe even the sun. Can they capture both time and glory, or will they lose track of both?

videos.title: Running Man's Weekly Keywords
videos.overview: This week's race is Running Man's Weekly Keyword! The cast revisits three hot topics that recently made waves on the show, each tied to a special mission requiring teamwork and "intensive research." To finish early and avoid the penalty, every member must cooperate and complete all the keyword-related tasks. Can they tackle the week's trending issues together, or will chaos and curiosity keep them working overtime?

videos.title: Collect and Win! Fall Literary Society Race
videos.overview: To welcome the autumn season, Kim Byoung Cheol, SUNMI, and MIYEON join the cast to form the Acrostic Poem Club for the Collect and Win! Fall Literary Society Race. This time, the competition takes a creative twist inspired by the classic Korean card game Hwatu. Split into four teams, members draw and exchange cards through missions in hopes of collecting the two maple leaf cards, known as jangttaeng, to claim first place. But they must be wary of the November Bright Card, which guarantees the penalty. Who will gather the perfect pair, and who will fall with the leaves?

videos.title: Dynamite Abandonment Race
videos.overview: Ahn Eun Jin and Kim Mu Jun, the stars of "Dynamite Kiss," join the cast for this week's explosive Dynamite Abandonment Race. It's an individual competition where every member starts with 20 penalty balls that can increase or decrease depending on what they choose to give up during the race. The prizes are plentiful, and greed will determine how they do throughout the race. With a chance at winning worthy prizes, the members and the guests give it their all to escape the penalty and go home bearing armfuls of gifts.

videos.title: This Is the Romance of It Race
videos.overview: Heo Kyeong Hwan joins the cast for this week's This Is the Romance of It race, set in the stunning coastal city of Tongyeong. Over a two-day getaway, the members take on three romantic courses, snapping photos and crafting captions to be judged by public votes on social media. Their mission is to prove their sense of romance while staying within the trip's budget. For every 50 dollars overspent, one member faces a penalty, but truly romantic moments can earn deductions. Can they balance love, laughter, and money in this picture-perfect race?

videos.title: This is the Romance of It Continues
videos.overview: This is the Romance of It continues in Tongyeong as the cast prepares a tuna dinner, but a wave of overly ambitious dishes leaves everyone wondering if they will finish in time. Afterwards, missions decide their sleeping arrangements, ranging from a luxury single room to a cramped four-person room. By morning, the members face one final opportunity to avoid the penalty, but only the earliest risers get a shot to compete. Who will wake up in time to secure their spot at the top?

videos.title: Problematic New Members Race
videos.overview: This week's race puts the spotlight on the newest members raised by Running Man in the Problematic New Members Race. Choi Daniel, Kang Hoon, and Ji Ye Eun are problematic member candidates, each known for their own chaotic traits. After missions that affect voting power, all members must vote for whom they think is the most problematic. The top vote-getter faces a penalty, but with a twist. New members can gamble on a reflection ticket to flip the outcome and punish their voters instead. Who will be labeled the most problematic, and who will outplay the vote?

videos.title: A Deceptive Holiday Gift Race
videos.overview: A festive gathering turns into a psychological battlefield as the members attempt to deduce the intended recipients of anonymous gifts ranging from pure gold to unwanted snow crabs. Seok Jin and Jae Seok face a blindfolded assassin game that threatens to destroy their long-standing alliance and ruin their holiday spirit. Trust is the first casualty of this celebration.

videos.title: Year-End Tax Settlement by Getting Rid of Prizes Race
videos.overview: The final race of the year turns Running Man's 2025 prizes into a tax nightmare, transforming past winnings into collectible badges. In the Year-End Tax Settlement by Getting Rid of Prizes race, members must shed as many badges as possible through missions and strategy. The one left with the most badges faces a penalty, while the rest risk penalty balls based on what remains. Who will successfully offload their winnings, and who will pay the price?

videos.title: Follow the Horse, Complete the Bingo Race
videos.overview: To ring in 2026, the Year of the Red Horse, the cast takes on the Follow the Horse, Complete the Bingo Race. Working as one team, they must clear horse-themed missions across a nine-square bingo board before the deadline. Each completed mission earns prize stickers, with bonus rewards for completing bingo lines. All stickers earned get placed onto dice that will decide everyone's fate. Can teamwork and strategy beat bad luck in this all-or-nothing New Year's race?

videos.title: Gold Bag Chaser, Gold Me More Race
videos.overview: Apink joins the cast this week to show off their golden friendship in the Gold Bag Chaser, Gold Me More Race. Divided into three teams, they must choose from identical briefcases, only one of which contains real gold. While stealing or swapping bags is allowed, teams will also earn hints through missions, making trust and deception key. When the Judgment Stand opens, each team can place only one bag, and only the team with the gold walks away with the prize. The rest will all face the penalty. Who will secure the gold, and who will be left empty-handed?

videos.title: The Lucky 2026 Orientation Day Race
videos.overview: Kwon Eun Bi joins to celebrate Running University's Class of 2026 in the Lucky 2026 Orientation Day Race. Through missions, members aim to collect Face Balls, used in a special Lucky Face Lottery, where they guess unlucky faces for prizes. Luck-enhancing items linked to secret missions may help, but only those with true fortune on their side will succeed. Who will ride their luck to victory, and who will end the day with a penalty?

videos.title: Starting From Today, I'm a Nine-Tailed Fox
videos.overview: Kim Hye Yoon and Lomon join as guests in The Starting from Today, I'm a Nine-Tailed Fox Race. In Gwangjin-gu, once known as Fox Valley, they take on the challenge of becoming nine-tailed foxes. Each member starts with a different number of tails, or none, and must carefully collect exactly nine to win a prize and dodge the penalty. But there's a twist. Collecting more than nine tails resets to zero. With no advantage to starting ahead and no room for error, strategy and restraint are key. Who will successfully become a nine-tailed fox, and who will end the day with a penalty?

videos.title: The TV Rating Notice Survival Race
videos.overview: The TV Rating Notice Survival Race gets underway to determine a new poster theme for the new year. Each member presents a concept they want to bring to life, but only one will survive a series of elimination missions to win. As alliances form and deception spreads, a tense battle of strategy and survival unfolds. Who will survive to see their vision become reality?

videos.title: Game of Two
videos.overview: Inspired by the episode airing in the second week of February, the Game of Two kicks off with guests Hong Jin Ho and Mimi, who perfectly personify the number two theme. Every mission revolves around the number two. A win earns prize balls, while losses add penalty balls. At the final draw, names are drawn at random, but only those called twice can claim a prize or suffer the penalty. Who will be the lucky winner?

videos.title: I'm the Magpie for the Lunar New Year's Day
videos.overview: To celebrate Lunar New Year, Kyu Hyun and Roy Kim join the cast for the festive I'm the Magpie for the Lunar New Year's Day. At the start, only three members are secretly chosen as magpies, while the rest become crows hoping to take their place. Through missions, members earn R coins to spend at a special shop, purchasing exchange, defense, or random draw cards to change their fate. Only the three who finish the race as magpies will receive prizes, while the remaining crows face penalties.

videos.title: The Great Gatsby Ji Birthday Heist
videos.overview: To celebrate Seok Jin's 60th birthday, Running Man throws the Great Gatsby Ji party, complete with special Big Nose Coins. The more coins members earn, the greater their advantage in the race. But chaos strikes when Seok Jin's coins vanish in a sudden heist. Now, the members must search for hidden clues or spend their coins wisely to track down the thief. The first to recover the stolen fortune wins it all and escapes the penalty. Who stole the coins?

videos.title: The 2026 Return of the Gamblers
videos.overview: The Card Shark Association returns for the 2026 Return of the Gamblers. Each member starts with 20 caramels, and the one with the most wins and chooses two members for the penalty. Yang Se Chan starts as the chairperson with the ability to reset the game once, but members are hot on his tail to impeach him by pooling caramels. With alliances forming and risky missions with huge payouts, who will outplay the others?

videos.title: Run and Fun Event Company: Spin the Roulette
videos.overview: Peak season hits the Run and Fun Event Company. Strong performances can earn incentives, but failure may lead to dreaded overtime. Through missions, members earn name stickers to place on either the Achievement Roulette for prizes or the Overtime Roulette for penalties. When both wheels spin, one member wins a prize while another is forced to work overtime. With alliances forming and hidden tasks offering clues, who will come out on top?

videos.title: Recharging Your Energy Is About Speed in Spring Race
videos.overview: National short track speed skaters Choi Min Jeong, Noh Do Hee, Lee June Seo, Lee Jeong Min, and Shin Dong Min join the cast for the Recharging Your Energy Is About Speed in Spring race. Every mission tests speed, and the faster a team performs, the more rewards and fewer penalty balls they earn. In the end, the team with the fewest penalty balls wins and escapes the penalty. Which team will prove to be the fastest?

videos.title: The Missing Masterpiece Case
videos.overview: Actor Park Shin Yang seeks help from the Running Man detectives when a priceless painting goes missing in his museum. Hidden among 20 artworks is the one authentic piece, cleverly mixed in with forgeries. Armed with clues placed around the venue, the members must search carefully and deduce which painting is the real one. Can they uncover the truth and close the missing painting case?

videos.title: You'd Probably Want a Bite Race
videos.overview: Sung Si Kyung and Lee Chang Sub join the cast for the You'd Probably Want a Bite race, where pride gets thrown aside for just one bite. With a strict budget at each restaurant, members must win missions to earn their chance to eat. Winners enjoy a full meal and receive food fighter badges, while losers go hungry and collect penalty badges. The number of badges will determine who wins and who escapes the penalty.

videos.title: War of the Bosses, Ladder of Destiny
videos.overview: The cast teams up with guests Shin Seung Ho and Jung Soo Jung for this week's War of the Bosses, Ladder of Destiny. Using a giant ghost leg board, they compete to claim the title of the nation's ultimate boss. The final outcomes are hidden, and each mission grants chances to draw lines that shape their fate. Landing on the boss spot means victory, while landing on a dud could lead to a penalty. Who will be the ultimate boss?

videos.title: The Art of Betting: The Birth of a Fighter
videos.overview: Hwasa and Young K join the cast for The Art of Betting: The Birth of a Fighter, a high-stakes race testing their variety skills. Members and guests compete in team-based missions with constantly shifting teams, making strategy a key factor. Before each round, they bet on the success of their team. Win and double the stake, lose and forfeit it all. The top three earn prizes, while the bottom three face penalties. Who will come out on top?

videos.title: Running Days: Codename R
videos.overview: Find the two spies who have infiltrated Gyeongseong's business elite! Musical legends Yu Jun Sang, Shin Sung Rok, and Park Eun Tae of Swing Days: Code Name A, join the race. With teams shifting throughout the race, confusion and suspicion run high. In this tense battle of deception, strategy, and chaos, will the spies stay hidden, or will the others uncover their existence?

videos.title: Infinite Accumulation With Destiny Race
videos.overview: In the scenic city of Yeoju, the cast celebrates Running Man's 800th episode with the Infinite Accumulation With Destiny Race. Every mission forces members to choose between two paths, the Fortunate Course or the Unfortunate Course. Choosing the Fortunate Course adds to a special donation fund, while the Unfortunate Course brings penalty balls. Two members will get picked for punishment. Will they choose Up or Down?

videos.title: Flower Path for Different Colors
videos.overview: Chungha and Jeon So Mi join the cast for the spring-themed Flower Path for Different Colors race, where fate is decided by color. Members must avoid matching their outfit colors with those randomly drawn on the boards or face disadvantages. With jackpots and shifting odds, the top three win prizes while the three lowest face penalties.

videos.title: Gold Stealer: Break Into the Safe
videos.overview: Kim Min Seok, Yoo Hee Kwan, and Chae Won Been join the cast for the Gold Stealer: Break Into the Safe race. As the guests and members try to outwit one another in a game full of traps, betrayals, and hidden schemes, unexpected love lines and shocking confessions throw everyone into chaos. From nostalgic tray-smashing missions to bizarre smell-based games, the race quickly spirals into confusion and laughter. In the end, only one team can crack open the safe and claim the real gold.

videos.title: Secret Payment
videos.overview: Gong Myoung returns to Running Man after seven years for a high-stakes spending race. The members must keep their card balances as close to zero as possible while navigating tempting missions and chaotic fortune readings. Unexpected love fortunes and competitive mind games quickly throw the cast into confusion. As rivalries heat up, a one-on-one name-tag battle returns with an unexpected new strategy.

videos.title: What's Wrong with Running Man?
videos.overview: Ahn Jae Hyeon and Kang So Ra join the cast for a race that forces the members to choose between a safe reward and a risky shot at something bigger. Their tiger moth instincts are pushed to the limit as greed, doubt, and psychological battles take over. Every choice could bring instant success or crushing regret. In this unpredictable race, who will trust the safe bet and who will risk it all?

videos.title: I Will Prove It With My Face
videos.overview: A major showdown unfolds in Sangam-dong as Seok Jin and Se Chan face off in a one-on-one name tag elimination battle. Actress Lee Ju Bin joins the race inspired by her legendary ID photo, as the members hunt for clues to complete the ultimate comedy-style ID picture. Forced into outrageous disguises, they must prove their variety instincts while avoiding a brutal overtime penalty.

videos.title: Solo Money Up
videos.overview: Jeon So Min and Kim Kyung Nam return for a Running Man-style battle of investment and strategy. The members must choose between risky all-in bets and cautious diversification as they compete to maximize their profits. With their fortunes tied to the success of a single season, every decision carries major consequences. In this race for profit, who will emerge as the smartest investor, and who will face the penalty?

videos.title: Dropping by Your Place for a Quick Visit
videos.overview: Kim Dong Hyun and Mimi join the cast for a race inspired by a surprise visit to Dong Hyun's home. With housewarming gift money on the line, the members must contain their endless spending temptations. Every choice and mission tests their ability to balance generosity and thrift. In this battle of willpower, will they have enough money in the end?

videos.title: Summer Soccer Vacation
videos.overview: The members head to a summer soccer training camp where teamwork is the key to survival. Faced with a penalty shootout challenge, they must work together to avoid riding one of the tallest and most terrifying attractions in the country. As pressure mounts, teamwork begins to crumble, and emotions run high. In this grueling summer race, who will keep their nerve until the end?

videos.title: Priceless New World
videos.overview: Hwang Kwang Hee and Lee Se Hee join the cast for a race where the members arrive in modern Seoul as either nobles or slaves from the Joseon era. Starting with different fortunes, they must change their status before the race ends. Those who remain as slaves face a penalty, while the nobles compete for a prize. Who will rise through the ranks before time runs out?

videos.title: Someday, a Big Fortune Will Come My Way
videos.overview: MIYEON and MINNIE join the members as failed CEOs hoping to stage a comeback and win a life-changing cash prize. By completing a series of assigned schedules, they earn daily wages that can be multiplied tenfold if they win the race. But with water ghosts secretly hiding among them and eliminating players, no one is safe. Who will survive and complete the ultimate comeback?

videos.title: Holding Onto the Edge of This Nostalgic Memory
videos.overview: Cho Hye Lyun and Song Eun I reunite with Seok Jin for a nostalgic race that takes everyone back to 1995. As veteran comedians and variety stars go head-to-head, they must rely on their wit and memories to overcome a series of challenges. With pride and old memories on the line, the competition is filled with laughter and surprises. Who will prove they remember the past the best?

videos.title: Off to Work, Yaho
videos.overview: This week's race determines the opening time for next week's episode. Already facing an extremely early call time, the cast must complete missions to delay the start as much as possible. With sleep and pride on the line, they fight to avoid another sunrise shoot! But the production crew has a tempting trick up its sleeve, luring the members to sacrifice precious time for valuable rewards. How early will they have to wake up next week?

videos.title: The Favorite Employee Race
videos.overview: Kang Hoon, Kim Hye Jun, and Cha Woo Min clock in for a fierce race to become the company's favorite employee, with bonus gold bars at stake. But when the gold suddenly vanishes, every employee falls under suspicion as they learn the embezzler is among them. The race for favor becomes a hunt for the hidden culprit.
